CustomField.description: The role that does this work, derived from the rule and its dimension. A role rather than a person: a name would be wrong in every org but the one it was written for, while a role maps onto whatever that org calls the team. The mapping is judgement and lives in scanner/rubric.json, not in the engine.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Which team this finding is for.
CustomField.label: Owner Role
